dataset.description: This dataset contains experimental data on the effects of humate treatments on cucumber plants (Cucumis sativus L.) under abiotic stress conditions. The purpose is to evaluate the effectiveness of humates as biostimulants in improving plant stress resistance and supporting the development of strategies for enhancing crop resilience.

distribution.title: The purpose of this dataset is to assess the impact of humate treatments on plant physiological responses under abiotic stress conditions, such as drought and temperature fluctuations. The data contribute to the project objective of enhancing plant stress resistance and improving crop productivity. The data will be generated through controlled experimental studies.

dataset.title: Humate Treatment Efficacy Dataset

dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of antioxidant activity in cucumber plants (Cucumis sativus L.) exposed to different abiotic stress conditions, such as temperature fluctuations and drought. The purpose of this dataset is to evaluate plant stress responses and to support the development of methods for early stress detection and improvement of plant stress resistance.

distribution.title: The purpose of this dataset is to evaluate antioxidant activity in cucumber plants (Cucumis sativus L.) under different abiotic stress conditions, such as temperature fluctuations and drought. The data support the project objective of developing an early diagnostic method for plant stress and improving stress resistance. The data will be generated through controlled laboratory and greenhouse experiments.

dataset.title: Antioxidant Activity Dataset

dataset.description: This dataset contains chlorophyll fluorescence measurements collected from cucumber plants (Cucumis sativus L.) under different abiotic stress conditions, including temperature fluctuations and drought.

distribution.title: The data will be used to assess early stress responses and to develop a rapid diagnostic model for plant stress resistance.

dataset.title: Chlorophyll Fluorescence Measurements Dataset

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) describes the types of data that will be generated and collected within the EXPLORERS project, as well as the procedures for data handling, storage, documentation, and sharing. The project focuses on the development of a rapid method for early detection of plant stress and enhancement of stress resistance in cucumber plants (Cucumis sativus L.) under abiotic stress conditions.
The plan ensures that data follow FAIR principles and are accessible for future research and reuse.
dmp.title: EXPLORERS: Development of an express method for early diagnosis and resilance of plant stress resistance (1.1.9/LZP/2/25/196)
